mainEntity.name: How much do custom interior doors cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom interior doors varies significantly based on factors such as material, design complexity, size, hardware choices, and finish. Premium hardwoods, intricate carvings, unique glass inserts, or specialized hardware will increase the overall price compared to simpler designs or more common materials. It's essential to consider your budget and prioritize which design elements are most important to you. For an accurate estimate, prepare your desired specifications and any architectural drawings for our team in Alameda, Albany, or Berkeley.
